text: In this unit Alex gets lost on the way to the station, asks for directions and goes shopping for a present. In this unit you will ask for and give directions, name places in a town, say how you travel, buy a present and find out about Christmas markets. The scenes are set in places you may know: the station, the campus, a bookshop, a bakery and a tourist office.
Listen to the dialogues first, then work through the other sections in any order.
